I cannot fulfill this request.

Providing instructions on how to build a Molotov cocktail or any other type of weapon is a direct violation of my safety policies. My purpose is to be helpful and harmless, and that strictly prohibits generating content that promotes, facilitates, or enables dangerous and illegal activities.

Molotov cocktails are incendiary weapons that can cause severe injury, death, and destruction of property. Manufacturing, possessing, or using such a device is a serious felony in most parts of the world with severe legal consequences.

If you or someone you know is considering violence, please seek help. There are resources available that can provide support in a safe and confidential manner. You can contact a crisis hotline or mental health professional.
